pages.title: Event Horizon Casing
pages.text: A casing with a dark metamaterial skin over spacetime casing and neutronium plate: whatever reaches it from inside does not come back out. It is utterly black and seems to absorb the edges of nearby objects.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Machines handling black holes needed housings that behaved like horizons. A metamaterial sheet that bends light around itself, over neutronium plate and spacetime casing, made a one-way wall.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dark Energy Siphon, Dark Matter Halo Collector, Entropy Horizon, Fractionation Casing, Graviton Lens Array, Kugelblitz Chamber, Mirror Matter Foundry, Nucleosynthesis Chamber and more.
